limitations: Denominator is the retained NBA schedule for queried dates; absence from these snapshots is not proof no game exists.
Mapped means a retained observation identifies the game, not that a market is currently open.
Timely means within the frozen 30-to-25-minute window. Eligibility still uses the original collector gates.
A missing observation is a collection gap, not a no-edge prediction. Stale schedule coverage remains explicitly stale.
Current historical settlement values and reported settlement times lack contemporaneous revision/publication certification.
Rest uses archived schedules; omitted games and historical schedule revisions remain unverified.
Only Oct-Dec2025 development is tested; five-season NBA rest coverage is not five-season Kalshi evaluation.
January-June2026 excluded as already examined; no fresh confirmation claim.
Few seven-day blocks and dependent teams limit uncertainty; no returns or fill claims.
Accepted reports are research output, not better predictions. Local applied patches are not deployments.
Usage holds are observed wall-clock intervals to the next differently phased event; concurrent task waits overlap and are not unique elapsed time.
The last-30 implementation delivery window differs from the last-24-hour activity window.
Operator integrations are reported separately; historical host promotion rows are not rewritten.

delivery.window: Most recent 30 background implementation assignments, including unfinished work.

confirmation.endpoint: first 300 admitted games after at least 60 calendar days

confirmation.acceptance: Only evaluate at frozen endpoint; upper paired game-bootstrap 95% bound below zero; descriptive result alone does not authorize trading

schedule.scope: Today and tomorrow Eastern, plus every date in discovered open NBA winner contracts

execution.amendment: Target 30 minutes before scheduled tipoff; admit first observed book at most 300 seconds late (30-to-25-minute window). This explicit sampling amendment is frozen before any eligible game.

limitations: Public REST receipt times are not exchange event timestamps.
Pregame regular-season predictions only; preseason observations are excluded.
Fees and execution are not verified; no filled trades or ROI claimed.
Coverage is per completed cycle; absent markets, mapping gaps and page guards remain explicit. It does not prove every NBA game has a tradable contract.
Historical Elo inputs lack original publication receipts; frozen model is research only.
Settlement revisions and fractional settlements excluded from binary Brier.
Metrics are separated by model; a later model never replaces an earlier prediction.

This is day-level calendar rest, not exact elapsed hours or travel fatigue.

contemporaneous_limitations: No independent historical publication witness; dated reconstruction only.
Fixed sampled report slots are not guaranteed latest pre-cutoff reports.

features.recommended_next_step: Join exact game/team and enforce report_at AND document_latest_at <= each Kalshi decision time; retain missing cases and add prospective receipts.

contemporaneous_limitations: Retrospective candidate rosters preserve observed appearances but that is not a point-in-time eligibility certificate.
Later distinct-team signings and revised articles cannot be backdated to remove players at an earlier decision.
Current rosters and same-game boxscore participation must not be used as historical pregame rosters.
features.recommended_next_step: Resolve historical knowledge/effective-time evidence or collect prospective roster snapshots; keep this feature disabled until then.

Previously explored 2024-26 confirmation seasons are not fresh holdout data.
